name: Immersive 3D UI
description: Additive deterministic and vision-assisted checks for WebGL and immersive interfaces.

ruleExtensions.instruction: When 3D is required, render a real canvas with a WebGL context; do not fake 3D with a flat background image.
Use a legitimate supported 3D dependency such as Three.js, React Three Fiber, or Babylon.js.
Provide depth or parallax through a pointer- or scroll-triggered transform that is visible in captured evidence.
Make the 3D surface respond to a synthetic pointer or scroll interaction with a measurable canvas-region change.
Keep Largest Contentful Paint and main-thread long tasks within the configured immersive performance budget.

tierB.name: immersiveness
tierB.condition: only scored when the immersive3d extension is enabled
tierB.instruction: Score whether the 3D elements feel deliberate, premium, and content-enhancing rather than a generic template bolted onto a flat page.
